ops.body:
Applied the root fix-group guidance (22:23Z).
- reposync DRAFT PR opened: https://github.com/yasyf/reposync/pull/5 (head cc-sync/worktree-snapshot @ 826a351, 5.4 KB body by the codex prose lane). The opener lane stopped because the body file lacked a TITLE line, so the coordinator opened it with the prose lane's reported title.
- The serial reposync final-fix stage (wf_85b9ef10-cc7) was stopped right after it started (no commits, clean tree). It is replaced by Run wf_bf3127a0-3a0:
  - triage: dedupe both lenses (13 + 12 findings, saved at reviews/reposync-final-lens{0,1}.md) into 3–4 independent fix groups (e.g. capture/LFS/index state; history/cache/ledger validity; receiver verify/restore/collision/network). EVERY file gets a single owning group, with explicit cross-group notes for shared schema/env files.
  - parallel group lanes in isolated worktrees (branches cc-sync/rs-fix-<group> from 826a351): every finding is reproduced as a failing real git/git-lfs/jj test first, then fixed or rejected with evidence. Unsupported state stays visibly incomplete; no silent data drop.
  - one merge lane pushes onto PR #5.
  - TARGETED per-group astra refutation (re-run each reproduction, try to break each fix, re-check each rejection) instead of another whole review; a refix only if a refuter finds something real.
  - docs via the codex prose lane, then PR #5 CI.
- Orca: the finish fix stage (wf_1a8cd60d-b5c) was mid-edit with uncommitted work, so it is allowed to finish its 9 lens-0 findings. The coordinator will stop that workflow before its QA stage and run the 8 reproduced lens-1-rerun findings (saved at reviews/orca-lens1-rerun.md; divergence re-run targeting, early cancel, a pending-resume reservation, dormant structured placeholders, editor-id remap, persisted launch preferences, newer_partial and not_restorable display) as parallel fix groups with targeted refutation, then run QA once.
- Speculative D15 sparse E2E scenario complete: cc-sync/e2e-sparse @ 2ae2afc.
